title: URL harvest with provenance
purpose: Fetch -> normalize -> sha256 -> staged candidate under logs/harvest-<ts>/ (raw.bin, meta.json, candidate.md). External content stays UNTRUSTED; adoption is always an explicit edit citing the hash. Never writes docs.

title: Restart the :5099 dashboard container
purpose: opencode-web is a compose service, not a command. Restarts it so :5099 serves the current checkout, then polls /api/rev until served==HEAD (stale=False) or fails loudly.

title: Gated promote: prove the page works, then serve it
purpose: The lesson of the 2026-10-12 freeze: rev-match is not page-works. Boots the new dashboard in a scratch process, runs the inline-script execution test (the detector we dismissed), and only on PASS recreates the container + re-verifies live. Failure prints rollback; never auto-reverts.

title: :4096 recovery probe with ledger logging
purpose: Asserts every :4096 stratum (containers, compose DNS, loopback+mesh TLS edge, dashboard, cert battery, authenticated data plane, session store readonly) with per-signature recovery hints; logs one RECOVERY row per check to observability.db for watchdog polling. Check-only by default; --recover allows one bounded restart+reprobe.

title: Over-budget / denied-model guidance with ledger logging
purpose: Reads session-health risks (every over/warn session, deny-listed free-tier models) and prints the numbered fresh-session guidance; logs ADVISORY rows for watchdog polling. Check-only; exit 1 when the focus is actionable.

title: Act on the budget STOP: produce the brief automatically (#76)
purpose: RULES #76 makes an over-budget session a hard STOP whose prescription is a handoff; this is the ACTION (detect and act were separate). Targets the LATEST over-budget session (the row preflight.sh gates on), runs the brief chain, and prints the paste path — no model call, never --fork/--continue. Idempotent: a brief already on disk is reused (--force regenerates), so a per-turn preflight is cheap after the first. preflight.sh invokes it on the budget STOP; JEV_AUTO_HANDOFF=0 disables.

title: Deterministic carry-over brief from a transcript
purpose: Builds a paste-ready brief (goal, findings, recent asks, tools, open question) from logs/transcript-<id>.md without a model call; every field passes through redact.mjs. --model only prints the prompt plus the spend command after an ALLOW verdict; it never calls a model.

title: Secrets-at-rest scan with rotation guidance
purpose: Finds secret-shaped lines (deepseek/jev keys, bearer tokens, env assignments) in artifact dirs (logs/, observability, notes). The report is value-free (file:line:kind only). Exit 1 names ./scripts/rotate-api-keys.sh plus the revoke consoles.

title: Rotate DeepSeek + JEV API keys (guided, interactive)
purpose: Browser revoke checklist, .env.local backup (0600), hidden-input new keys, atomic rewrite, container recreate, smoke test. Run in a terminal; the dashboard /manage page is read-only and cannot do this.

title: Rotate the :4096/:5099 Basic-auth password (guided, interactive)
purpose: Backup, token_urlsafe replacement, atomic single-line rewrite (0600), container RECREATE (env_file is creation-time; restart keeps the old value), then proves new=200 and old=401. Neither value is ever printed. Run in a terminal; /manage is read-only.

title: Periodic threshold monitor with ledger trips
purpose: One sweep: latest-session over-budget/deny-listed trips (T1/T2), new gateway-failure lines since cursor (T3), slow caddy fetches (T4), non-latest deny-listed/over-budget active sessions (T5/T6), a stalled running tool (T7), and a flapping peer tunnel (T8: >= SENTINEL_TUNNEL_MIN, default 4, teardown/re-handshake events for the nebula unit). History only reported. Logs ADVISORY rows for watchdog polling. Runs under systemd/opencode-sentinel.timer every 5 min (see sentinel-install).

title: Gantt timeline of what made a session slow
purpose: Reads part timings (readonly) plus the caddy access log and draws one session's agentic-loop cadence against the slow fetches that queued behind it. --json for machines. Shows serial-loop starvation, not averages.

title: Snapshot + verified restore of irreplaceable state
purpose: Copies secrets/certs/config (and the store with --with-db) into a 0700 dir with a sha256 manifest; restore verifies checksums and snapshots current state first. Nothing is printed by value. Run before risky changes.

title: Transcript from the store, no browser required
purpose: Reads messages+parts straight from opencode.db (readonly) in the re-extract shape when the tab will not render or the message route stalls. Same caps; feeds handoff-brief.sh. Never paste the raw file (may hold pasted secrets).

title: Committed-media size gate
purpose: Fail-closed budgets for tracked media (video <=2MiB, images <=150KiB). Wired into test-hygiene.sh.

title: Contention-evidence snapshot
purpose: Observe-only PSI/CPU/nebula/D-state/swap snapshot to logs/. Run twice ~60s apart and diff. Sends no signals.

title: Name the nebula restarter (read-only)
purpose: Another project's supervisor restarts nebula (3 PIDs/10 min) and systemd never counts it. This reads /proc parent chains and names the restarter (WATCH SECS catches churn live). Read-only: no signals, kills nothing.

title: Rate-limit + right-size nebula (host, sudo)
purpose: NEBULA-1: the trace named systemd (PID 1) as the parent, but the live --diagnose falsified the churn premise (NRestarts=0, one stable PID; the recurring event is a TUNNEL flap). This writes an idempotent systemd drop-in (StartLimit* + CPU/IO/Memory/LogRateLimit) as a defensive ceiling and CLASSIFIES restart-churn vs tunnel-flap. Dry-run by default; --apply/--revert/--show/--diagnose; sudo only on write.

title: External-state bridge for issue hand-offs
purpose: E2: gh is absent in-container, so an issue hand-off (nebula-systemd-override.sh --handoff) had no read-back. `link` records a filed issue (repo#number) as an open external unit; `poll` reads its state — gh on the host (--gh), a host-written JSON file (--in, default data/observability/issue-state.json), or the public GitHub REST API from the container (--api, stdlib, no gh/token) — into the same ledger triage/next-action read, idempotently; `status` prints the latest state. next-action.sh surfaces open external issues.

title: Durable, addressed task identity (E4)
purpose: E4: a TODO unit has no stable ID and the DB `todo` is session-local, so a unit cannot be addressed across sessions. Records TASK/TASK_STATE rows on the same ledger triage/next-action read: `new --title T [--id ID] [--owner A]` mints (or returns, by title) a stable id (T-<6hex>, or an explicit --id like TUNNEL-1) and records title + owner; `close --id|--title` ends it; `show`/`list [--all]` read the latest state. Idempotent by source_key. loop-state.sh --begin registers the unit, --end closes it; next-action.sh surfaces open tasks.

title: Recover host->docker port path (sudo)
purpose: Probes mapped ports; if down, restarts the docker daemon after typed YES. Nothing in-repo can fix this path.

title: G4 opt-in proxy routing switch
purpose: Backs up opencode.json, swaps deepseek provider to :4000 proxy, restarts web. --revert restores. Typed YES required.

title: Event ledger (gates + guard verdicts)
purpose: Append-only rows in observability.db ledger (harness GATE_START/GATE, guard.log verdicts, backfill). Queryable history; read via logs.sh --source ledger. Idempotent backfill.

title: Whole-state check
purpose: Every gate (lint, test-hygiene, test-patterns, test-dashboard) + telemetry + cost + TODO in-flight. --json for wrappers.

title: Spend gate (fail closed)
purpose: Refuses (exit 1) unless keys, last gate run, balance and model policy all pass. Run before any paid session.

title: Model catalog + cost policy
purpose: ALLOW / ASK / BLOCK from models.policy.json; also the data behind the /models page.

title: Learned rules (corpus)
purpose: Contrastive (state, action, outcome) rules -> data/observability/learned-rules.json; the guard reads them.

title: Solution library
purpose: Recurring errors and the next action that fixed each -> solutions.json; shown on /explore > patterns.

title: Search (ranked + fuzzy)
purpose: FTS5/bm25 over every part; --fuzzy tolerates typos (edti -> edit).

title: Telemetry
purpose: guard actions, tool errors + traces, events, app log, container log, packet hint.

title: Doc budget
purpose: Token size + content hash of the read-first corpus; unchanged hash = nothing new to re-learn.

title: Blacklist guard self-test
purpose: Proves block/fix/warn plus interpreter-wrapper and pipe-to-shell catches.

title: Tool contract tests
purpose: Asserts every --json tool emits the keys a wrapper reads.

title: Health check
purpose: Ordered tiers; --full adds the Jev proof (Tier 9) and repo gates (Tier 10).

title: UX test (Playwright)
purpose: Asserts the served pages: console clean, no 390px overflow, tabs toggle, overview compact.
commands: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium

title: UX trace (clicks/drags/scrolls + hotspots)
purpose: Logs every click/drag/scroll with screenshots + hotspots into ux.db; --ocr reads the shots back to text. The handoff substrate.

title: Read a screenshot locally
purpose: OCR fallback when image input is unavailable (tesseract / PaddleOCR); searchable via /api/semantic.

title: Cost accounting
purpose: DeepSeek balance + per-session cost + Jev count; bottlenecks, model mix, prompt cache, context budget.

title: GitHub Pages via gh api (no clicking)
purpose: Pages source, Deploy panel dispatch (= allow-once), run watch, URL. Requires gh auth login. Dispatch replaces the Actions UI click.

title: Session health (stalls / blank turns)
purpose: Read-only, browser-independent detection of stalled (running tool) and blank (no text after the last tool) turns straight from opencode.db. Interactive tools (a pending `question`, which blocks on the OPERATOR) are excluded. Surfaces at /explore ▸ signals and /api/health; --live also reads /session/status.

title: Quirks (symptom → known issue, fuzzy)
purpose: Correlate a symptom with a vendored map of known upstream issues (fuzzy text + typo tolerant), fuzzily search the chat DB, repo code and docs, and show a per-model quirk ledger (tool-error rate + sed/2>/dev/null/subprocess usage). Offline, no network. /api/health carries the correlations and per-model ledger.

title: Live-page CDP probe (real Chrome)
purpose: Attaches to headed google-chrome-stable over CDP and reads rendered state: what the LIVE :5099/:4096 pages show right now (tabs, text, eval, screenshots). Zero-dependency (Node 22 fetch+WebSocket); needs the browser open with --remote-debugging-port. `probe` cross-checks :4096 session ids vs rendered :5099 rows.

title: GitHub Pages panel export (consent-gated)
purpose: Redacted static snapshot (aggregates + session rows, no message text) for Pages. Interactive consent: allow once / allow always / deny. CI assembles committed site-data/panel.json only; the DB never leaves the host.

title: Redact secrets at egress
purpose: Strips key shapes (sk-, apikey_, JWT, Bearer) and NAME=value secrets from exports (/api/export/session, sessions/patterns/guard CSVs); also a stdin filter. Defence in depth for a value already in the transcript.

title: Make the user's own Chrome CDP-reachable + forward it
purpose: Chrome M136+ refuses --remote-debugging-port on the DEFAULT profile ("requires a non-default data directory") and a fresh /tmp profile is logged out. Stops any running Chrome (typed YES unless --yes), launches CDP on a NON-default --user-data-dir, and with --clone-default seeds it from ~/.config/google-chrome so logins persist; forwards the port with socat so the sandbox can attach via cdp-tab.mjs (RULES #62). UI-only GitHub steps (e.g. minting a fine-grained PAT) run here, not gh api (#63).

title: Install browser-use + selenium into a venv
purpose: This image ships no pip/ensurepip, so the script creates a venv with --without-pip and bootstraps pip via get-pip.py, then installs browser-use + selenium. Both drive the already-open browser over CDP (RULES #62); browser-use works via pure-Python cdp-use (verified: lists host tabs). Selenium is installed but its chromedriver needs libnss3/libnspr4/libdbus-1, absent here with no sudo, so it only runs where those libs exist (e.g. the host).

title: Benchmark browser drivers + emit failover order
purpose: Probes every CDP browser driver against the live endpoint (cdp_tab, playwright, browser_use, selenium) for the same op (enumerate tabs) and writes data/observability/browser-drivers.json with order[] fastest-working-first. Callers take order[0] and fail over down the list on runtime error; SKIP is not PASS. Measured: cdp_tab ~1.3s < playwright ~11s < browser_use ~25s; selenium FAIL (chromedriver needs libnss3/libnspr4/libdbus-1).

title: Live UX smoke for the :5099 pages (e2e bridge)
purpose: CDP-driven UX assertions (through the host browser, RULES #62) over all six :5099 pages: each LOADS, lang set, one h1, main+skip, no leftover 'loading...', the empty Session-detail card is hidden on load, and the board Gantt+Kanban render. Runnable-now bridge to tester-army/e2e (run the full natural-language framework on the host). Writes data/observability/ux-smoke.json; exit 2 on any failure.

title: Ask a vision model what is on screen (semantic UX)
purpose: POSTs a screenshot to the allow-listed gemini-2.5-flash and returns an answer, for semantic UX assertions the garbled local OCR cannot make (e.g. 'is the Gantt visible?'). Key GEMINI_API_KEY (the shipped value is a placeholder; needs a real key).
commands: python3 scripts/vision-ask.py --image shot.png --question 'Is a Gantt chart visible? yes/no'

title: GATED Claude escalation/reviewer (RULES #68)
purpose: ASK-tier, deliberation-only. Refuses unless --reason AND --yes (consult the operator first); --dry-run prints plan + cost estimate. Escalation / second opinion only (fills the Jev-MCP gap); never the default, never vision. Key ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

title: Push sentinel FAIL flags to a webhook (alerting)
purpose: The alerting capability the observability tools have and this stack lacked: reads observability.db ledger (ADVISORY/FAIL), builds JSON, POSTs to $NOTIFY_WEBHOOK. No webhook -> prints payload and SKIPs (exit 0). No model spend, no backend.

title: Read-only causal audit of a TUI session's turns
purpose: Answers 'why did this session have issues' from the opencode store and names the CAUSE (which tool, which blacklist rule, which error signature), not just counts. Picks the TUI session (directory != /home/node/.opencode) when --session is omitted. Read-only, no model calls.

title: Search stored history (durable search_history)
purpose: Search the opencode store's parts (text/tool/reasoning) by substring, read-only, so a fresh session after a handoff can still reach the transcript it left behind (pi-durable search_history).

title: Semantic beforeTool guard (memoized)
purpose: durable-pi jev-damage-control analog: ask the cheap SubQ Snap classifier whether a shell command is irreversible/destructive and BLOCK it; the verdict is a durable memo (a restart never re-asks); fails open if unreachable. Exit 1 = BLOCK.

title: Bound crash-looping/oversubscribing services
purpose: Emit (or --apply) a systemd user drop-in for deepseek-harness.service with Restart/StartLimitBurst/CPUQuota/MemoryMax, plus the docker compose cpus note, so a crash loop cannot starve the box (ws24 lockup).

title: Capture README screenshots + demo video (host)
purpose: Launch a chromium via Playwright and capture one PNG per panel (home Flags, board Gantt+estimate, trends) plus a short .webm tour for the README; shrinks shots under the media budget. Run where a browser can launch (host).

title: Resolve the browser venv python (host)
purpose: Picks a Python with the browser stack (playwright/browser-use/selenium): BROWSER_VENV, else ~/.venvs/browser, else /home/owner/.venvs/browser, then execs a script with it. Makes ux-smoke/browser_bench/panels-tour durable across container resets. Run where the browser lives (the host) - the container's python is a different version.

title: Scripted NOTIFY_WEBHOOK setup + probe
purpose: Replaces hand-typing: validates a webhook URL (rejects placeholders like REPLACE-WITH-YOUR-UUID / <url> / example.), writes it to .env.local (0600), and proves it with a real POST so the sentinel timer (EnvironmentFile) pushes on a trip. --show/--test/--unset/--self-test.

title: Self-host the alert sink + point NOTIFY_WEBHOOK at it
purpose: One command: writes a systemd user unit for notify-sink.mjs, enables it (host), sets NOTIFY_WEBHOOK=http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hook via notify-setup.sh, and probes. Replaces the external-webhook requirement.

title: Self-hosted webhook sink (no third party)
purpose: Zero-dep node http sink: POST /hook appends JSONL to data/observability/notify-sink.jsonl; GET / shows recent; /health ok. Lets NOTIFY_WEBHOOK point at http://127.0.0.1:8788/hook so alerting needs no Slack/Discord URL. --self-test.

title: Triage the pushed alerts -> next command + runbook
purpose: Reads the DURABLE ledger (source of truth -- so an alert that failed to POST is still triaged; --in reads the delivery-log sink instead), de-dupes the stable-key FAIL flags, classifies each (over_budget/stall/slow_fetch/deny_listed), and prints severity + the exact next command + the runbook. Plain selectable text; --json for machines; --out writes the brief. Closes detect->push->act.

title: Checkpoint / resume for multi-step shell jobs
purpose: pi-durable's 'every step stores a checkpoint': records each completed step durably (data/observability/jobs/<job>.jsonl) so re-running a job SKIPS done steps and resumes after a crash instead of repeating. --force re-runs, --status/--reset, --self-test offline.

title: Validate Caddyfile -> restart caddy -> verify (checkpointed)
purpose: The typed Caddy sequence as a checkpointed script (durable-run): validate, restart, verify :5099 serves. A crash mid-way resumes at the next step. Host-only (docker).

title: Rebuild every derived artifact from storage
purpose: Proves pi-durable's 'storage is the source of truth': regenerates the alert brief (ledger -> data/observability/triage-<date>.md) and the latest-session digest (opencode store -> digests/<id>.md) from storage ALONE. Delete the outputs and re-run and they return.

title: Stand up the Grafana + SQLite ops view
purpose: One command to bring up Grafana (RULE #67) reading the two SQLite stores read-only -- one more client of the same committed state. Waits for /api/health. Host-only (docker).

title: Prove the durable properties (offline)
purpose: A green run proves the durability mechanisms are wired: triage reads the durable source, long jobs checkpoint/resume, derived state rebuilds from storage, a read-only client attaches. Wired into test-hygiene.

title: Find / test a free TCP port (never assume one)
purpose: Port conflicts recur (18x 'already in use' in the chat DB). Any script that binds/publishes a port should discover it, not assume it. Prints the first free loopback port >= START; --check PORT (exit 0/1), --owner PORT (best effort), --self-test offline.

title: Audit the BTRFS snapshot system (is it costing us?)
purpose: snapper-on-BTRFS root (/.snapshots/NNNN/snapshot): read-only check of retention limits, pinned CoW space, whether qgroups/quota are on, and whether locate indexes every snapshot. Prints the exact tuning commands.

title: Keep heavy trees out of the locate index
purpose: updatedb walks the whole tree unless PRUNEPATHS prunes it. Adds the costly paths (default: /.snapshots /var/lib/docker /var/lib/flatpak /var/lib/libvirt /mnt) idempotently with a timestamped backup, then rebuilds with updatedb at IDLE priority (ionice -c3 nice -n19) so it yields to your work. --paths to override; --no-updatedb to edit only. If locate is not needed, --disable-timer stops the recurring crawl (plocate-updatedb.timer / mlocate-updatedb.timer).

title: Live progress for a silent process
purpose: Background jobs like updatedb print nothing and look hung. Prints every few seconds: state/elapsed/CPU, /proc read counters, and the process cwd (for a tree walker, cwd is the progress bar). Read-only; never signals the process. Run with sudo for /proc/<pid>/io.

title: File search: fd (fallback find)
purpose: fd is installed on the host: fast, .gitignore-aware, no whole-tree index -- the on-demand replacement for locate on a slow disk. ffind prefers fd and falls back to find where fd is absent (e.g. this container). find stays the right tool for -delete/-printf/exact-name scripts.

title: Durable next-action / progress consumer
purpose: Consumes the durable store a session leaves behind (git state, last-gate.json, the ledger, TODO's queue, docs.json) and prints the exact next unit plus what changed since the last gate. A fresh session starts here with zero re-derivation -- no transcript replay. Read-only, no model call.

title: Dev-loop progress supervisor (timer)
purpose: Sentinel sibling for pi-durable's other half: is the loop still advancing? Records a durable PASS row on a rev/gate advance and a FAIL row when the loop stalls (no advance for PROGRESS_STALL_TICKS sweeps). Stable per-incident keys; only news trips. Install: ./scripts/progress-review-install.sh.

title: Durable dev-loop segment checkpoint
purpose: Checkpoint the in-flight loop segment on durable-run.sh's job store (job dev-loop): --begin records the unit + rev, --end records the gate result; --show reports the in-flight segment and the last done unit. A fresh session resumes/skips the segment instead of re-deriving it. --begin also takes the E3 single-writer lease (loop-lock.sh); --end releases it.

title: Single-writer lease for the dev loop (E3)
purpose: E3 concurrency lock: the dev loop has several shared writers and no merge key, so two live sessions can clobber each other. A TTL lease (default 1800s), actor-tagged, with explicit stale + forced takeover. --acquire [--unit U] [--force], --refresh, --release [--force], --status [--json], --check (exit 3 when another LIVE holder owns it). A dead holder is reclaimed by TTL, never by replaying history. flock-serialised, atomic write. Used by loop-state.sh --begin; surfaced by next-action.sh.

title: Embeddings rerank over FTS5 (redaction + hard cap)
purpose: Rerank bm25 candidates by embedding cosine. OFFLINE by default (deterministic hashing embedder); the external path refuses unless RERANK_ALLOW=1, passes every text through redact.mjs first, and obeys RERANK_MAX_TEXTS / RERANK_MAX_REQUESTS (over cap = refusal, not truncation). --fts pulls candidates straight from the semantic-search index.

title: Audit deployment config vs the expected spec
purpose: Compare the actual deployment settings against an expected spec and surface every drift with a remediation hint. Read-only; a human table by default, or --json for the :5099 dashboard.

title: Every assert, one command (agents contract)
purpose: Run all sandbox-runnable gates (lint, hygiene, patterns, self-tests, yaml contract, backup freshness, cert coverage, secret scan, opencode.json, review-diff, recall smoke, pages export). Host-only asserts print SKIP with the exact host command instead of failing (RULES #37). Exit 0 no FAIL, 2 otherwise.

title: Pre-push semantic review gate
purpose: Review the working-tree diff (deterministic file selection plus an LLM pass). Degrades to SKIP when the reviewer is not installed, never FAIL, because a missing optional tool must not block a push (RULES #37). Exit 0 clean or SKIP, 2 findings.

title: Verify OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD handling has no drift
purpose: 4-gate verification that password handling is consistent across web.sh, .env.local and the running container (warn-on-mismatch, no-warn-when-absent, doctor Tier 2, container agreement).

title: Add nofail to the /mnt/nvme fstab entry
purpose: Add nofail and x-systemd.device-timeout to the /mnt/nvme entry in /etc/fstab, then verify the generated systemd mount unit reflects the change.

title: Report and, on request, apply fstab nofail
purpose: Report and, on request, apply the nofail and x-systemd.device-timeout options to the /mnt/nvme fstab entry (the verify-side twin of apply-fstab-nofail.sh).

title: Exercise every tool in scripts/ and report pass/fail
purpose: Invoke each script in scripts/ once, with the smallest input that exercises it, and report pass/fail. --full adds the model round-trips and the grounded chatlog summarize. Wired into no gate; run on demand while a watcher is active.

title: Tail the test-tools status file and per-test logs
purpose: Follow scripts/archive/logs/test-tools.status (created by test-tools.sh) and, optionally, one test log, so a long test-tools run is visible in real time.

title: Run test-tools.sh with the watcher active
purpose: Run test-tools.sh while the watcher is active, so the transition timeline is visible in real time and preserved as a log file.

title: Report which agentic tools/models exist on this host
purpose: Print one line per agentic tool/model (present + version, or MISSING) so a tool evaluation starts from fact, not memory (evaluations rot). Offline, read-only, no egress, no installs.

title: A/B the same payload through Jev vs self-hosted Laya
purpose: Send the same typed-decision payload through TypeSafe Jev and a self-hosted Laya server (Jev-API-compatible, POST /v1/systemone), then diff the answers and report latency. Persists each run to observability.db (served at /api/ab).

title: Index and flag the repo's own code
purpose: Assemble, index and flag the repo code into data/observability/code.db (per-file metadata, top-level symbols, blacklist patterns, TODO/FIXME) so code sits beside the chat DB. Free, local, read-only over the repo.

title: Keyword recall over opencode sessions
purpose: Hermes-style keyword recall (read-only, sqlite mode=ro): search session titles first, then message bodies, printing id + directory + title + updated time as provenance.

title: Minimal MCP server over the repo's read-only tools
purpose: One MCP (stdio) server exposing probe_status, recall_sessions, findings and cost as tools so any agent calls them instead of pasted shell. No dependencies (Node 22); add to opencode.json mcp.servers.

title: Local OCR via tesseract.js (WASM)
purpose: Local OCR with tesseract.js — no apt/pip/API; the same engine as receipts-ocr's browser side. Downscales oversized images before OCR so very tall screenshots do not stall the detector.

title: Downscale a PNG to a byte budget
purpose: Downscale a PNG to fit a byte budget (box filter, opaque RGB) using the repo-pinned pngjs (no apt/pip). Overwrites the input file.

title: One router for the web-probe workflow
purpose: A single verb table shared by interactive and unattended runs, mirroring agents/probe.yaml in order. Run on the host from the repo root.

title: Guided :5099 findings control
purpose: Fetch /api/health and translate each finding into plain language (what it means, whether to care, the scripted action). Reports outstanding findings AND the standout positives (cost, balance, rev currency, counts).

title: Scripted probe telemetry with a deterministic next action
purpose: Source .env.local (never printed), run the probe, then report verdict/counts/reasons + screenshot sizes + live DOM markers and print the deterministic next action. Exit 0 PASS, 2 FAIL.

title: Roaming test from a hotspot-tethered client
purpose: Prove the overlay URLs survive a LAN switch that kills LAN-bound URLs. Run on the roaming box; read-only except a fresh /tmp Chrome CDP profile. Exit 0 all-green, 2 otherwise.

title: Localize long delays on the :5099/:4096 hop
purpose: Measure the phases a request pays (dns -> connect -> tls -> ttfb -> total) against the host URL and the loopback, repeatedly, and name the dominant phase. Run on the host.

title: Deduce steps to expose :4096/:5099 off-LAN
purpose: Read-only: print a verdict + next commands for exposing the ports off-LAN. Firewall changes live in the eero phone app. Run on the host.

title: Scripted Caddy access-plane verification
purpose: Check container Running (not merely Created), published bindings on 4096/5099, access-log lines for the session referer + /global/event SSE outcomes, and absence of 401/403 denials. Exit 0 all-green, 2 otherwise.

title: LAN TLS: IP SAN + caddy reload + trust + verify
purpose: Idempotent LAN certificate path (IP SAN, caddy reload, trust, verify); no port forwarding needed (eero/phone-app untouched). Run on the host from the repo root.

title: TLS verification battery as code
purpose: Everything once typed by hand during the BAD_CERT_DOMAIN incident, now one command: served fingerprint == file fingerprint, chain/SAN/expiry, etc. --playwright adds the browser check. Exit 0 only if all pass.

title: Confirm post-recreate loads on the .24 host
purpose: Check litellm config accepted (fallbacks live, no config error), opencode-web picked up the repo MCP server + wizard skill, and the models endpoint answers. Read-only. Exit 0 all-green.

title: Read-only DNS-forensics collector
purpose: Collect DNS forensics (sections A-C) on a FAILING box and paste all output back. Changes nothing: no restarts, no writes outside /tmp/opencode-dns.txt.

title: DNS recovery-loop telemetry
purpose: Detection always runs, remediation only with --fix, using the ledger DB as the durable record so the next occurrence is a lookup, not a fresh investigation.

title: Show the opencode-web container logs
purpose: cd into docker/ first so docker compose finds its config. Last 80 lines by default; -f follows.

title: Stop the OpenCode web UI container
purpose: Stop the opencode-web container. This takes the :5099 dashboard down until the entrypoint reruns (it comes back in a few seconds).

title: Arm/verify the durable background agents in one command
purpose: The loop has five always-on agents (sentinel 5m, notify-sink service, progress-review 15m, fts-refresh 15m, proactive 15m), each with its own installer, so arming them one by one is easy to half-do. --install runs the tested installers in order; --status prints unit present + enabled + active and SKIP (not pass) when systemctl is absent; --dry-run lists the commands; --self-test checks the nine unit templates and the five installers offline.

title: Turn NEW alerts into owned tasks + a durable digest
purpose: The loop detects (sentinel/progress-review) and acts on a budget STOP, but lacked a consumer that turns NEW ADVISORY rows into owned work. Cursor-bounded: the first run bootstraps the cursor and creates no historical tasks; later runs register at most PROACTIVE_MAX_NEW new alerts as tasks (owner `proactive`, idempotent by title) and write data/observability/proactive.json; a preflight STOP runs auto-handoff. --once, --self-test (offline seams). Timer via proactive-install.sh.

title: Install the proactive-agent timer
purpose: User-level systemd timer (every 15 min, randomized) running proactive-agent.sh --once. No sudo; idempotent; --write-only, --uninstall, --self-test. The first sweep bootstraps the cursor (no historical task flood).

title: Install the FTS base refresh timer
purpose: The dashboard serves /api/semantic from the atomic on-disk FTS base + an in-memory overlay for new parts, so the base must be refreshed out-of-band. Installs a user-level timer (every 15 min, randomized, Nice=19/idle/CPUQuota=50%) that runs semantic-search.sh --rebuild (temp+rename, readers never see a partial index). SKIP/not-pass without systemctl; --write-only, --uninstall, --self-test.

title: Offline accessibility/usability audit for served HTML
purpose: WCAG-basics gate with no browser or network: lang/title/viewport, one h1 with no skipped levels, skip-link target with tabindex=-1, named nav landmark, image alt, accessible names for buttons/inputs/role controls, :focus-visible (no stray outline:none), prefers-reduced-motion when motion CSS exists, and contrast for the dark/light theme tokens. Accepts files or --url, --json, --self-test; wired into test-dashboard.sh against the scratch build.

title: Read-only entanglement audit across local checkouts
purpose: Answers with evidence which checkouts exist, what repo/branch/HEAD each tracks, whether worktrees are dirty, whether duplicate files drifted, and which tree the live containers serve. Never commits, pushes, restarts, or removes anything; exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 usage/tool error.

title: Bounded packet capture for reset forensics
purpose: mtr --report baseline then `host REMOTE and tcp port PORT` capture for SECONDS with a 10 MB rotate cap into logs/. Needs CAP_NET_RAW/root (prints SKIP, not PASS, without it); fixed filter template, no user bpf, captures never leave logs/. Analyze with net-rst.sh.

title: List TCP resets in a capture (read-only)
purpose: Prints timestamp, direction, and ports for every RST in a PCAP using tcpdump in read mode (no tshark/GUI). A reset's source address is evidence, not proof: middleboxes can inject packets and captures can miss traffic.

title: SSH banner/algorithm audit for one host
purpose: Tests the negotiation branch of a reset: weak legacy algorithms, client/server mismatch, or an unexpected banner (middlebox). Banner grab + algorithm lists only (no credentials, no auth attempts). Prints SKIP with the exact install line if ssh-audit is absent.

title: TUNNEL-1 LINK evidence bundle (host, read-only)
purpose: One shot for issue #5: unit state, flap count/last lines, overlay ping, DF/MTU 1400/1472, local UDP :4242 listeners, and a process snapshot, each with a timeout so nothing looks hung. Classifies restart-churn vs tunnel-flap vs overlay-unreachable vs no-evidence; writes logs/tunnel-link-<ts>.log. Read-only; --no-net for unit/journal only.
